Toronto Raptors (5-6, seventh in the Eastern Conference) vs. Philadelphia 76ers (9-3, second in the Eastern Conference)
              Philadelphia; Thursday, 7 p.m. EST
              LINE: 76ers -10.5; over/under is 221.5
              BOTTOM LINE: Eastern Conference foes Philadelphia and Toronto will play on Thursday.
              Philadelphia finished 45-37 overall, 27-25 in Eastern Conference play and 23-18 at home during the 2025-26 season. The 76ers averaged 24.6 assists per game on 41.7 made field goals last season.
              Toronto went 46-36 overall and 5-12 in Atlantic Division play during the 2025-26 season. The Raptors averaged 114.6 points per game last season, 53.2 in the paint, 20.0 off of turnovers and 18.9 on fast breaks.
              INJURIES: 76ers: Ariel Hukporti: out for season (achilles), LeBron James: day to day (back), Joel Embiid: day to day (foot), Adem Bona: out (spine), Dominick Barlow: out (back).
              Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: out (knee), Nate Bittle: day to day (foot), Scottie Barnes: day to day (adductor), Trayce Jackson-Davis: day to day (illness).
